Container.Name: gambit
Container.Overview: gambit - the rule-builder / dry-run dashboard for an autonomous trading-research bot. Create paper accounts, attach trading rules, and watch positions, tax lots and simulated orders on a local SQLite ledger; compare every strategy against buy-and-hold; see each Alpaca paper account's state and the kill switch; and see every call gambit makes to tape (the Usage page). It reads market data from a tape service at TAPE_BASE_URL using its own data-scope client. Orders go only to an Alpaca PAPER account, when its keys are set. LOGIN: every page sits behind a sign-in that admits exactly ONE account (GAMBIT_ALLOWED_EMAIL). It REFUSES TO START unless a login method is set: GAMBIT_LAN_PASSWORD (email plus password, works at the container's plain-http LAN address) and/or the three Google variables (Google accepts https on a real domain or localhost, never a bare LAN IP). The Data path holds gambit.db, the paper-trading ledger - back it up. Runs as uid 99, gid 100 (nobody:users).
Container.Description: gambit - rule-builder / dry-run dashboard (FastAPI), behind a single-account sign-in (LAN password and/or Google).

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: App HTTP port. Plain http on the LAN is fine with the LAN login; put an https reverse proxy in front only if you use Google sign-in.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds gambit.db (the paper-trading ledger: accounts, rules, simulated orders, tax lots, and the log of every tape call) and the tape response cache. The ledger is append-only history with no re-importable source - losing it loses that history. The container runs as uid 99, gid 100 (nobody:users), what Unraid gives appdata; a directory owned otherwise must be made writable by 99:100. REQUIRED - an absolute path on a POOL.

Config.Name: TAPE_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Address of the tape service gambit reads market data from, e.g. http://192.0.2.72:8000 - the tape container's LAN address, with no proxy or public hostname in between. Empty falls back to the built-in default, which is a documentation address and will not answer: set it.

Config.Name: TAPE_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Client id gambit presents to tape (X-Client-Id). Its scope is data only, read-only.

Config.Name: TAPE_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Secret of that tape client. Without it the dashboard still runs, with no live prices or Compare benchmarks.

Config.Name: GAMBIT_SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: REQUIRED. At least 32 random characters; signs the sign-in session cookie. Changing it signs every session out, nothing else.

Config.Name: GAMBIT_ALLOWED_EMAIL
Config.Description: REQUIRED. The ONE account allowed past the sign-in (case-insensitive): the email typed at the LAN login, and the Google account for Google sign-in. Every other account is refused. Changing it signs out any session issued to the previous address.

Config.Name: GAMBIT_LAN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: LAN login password, at least 12 characters, used with GAMBIT_ALLOWED_EMAIL at the dashboard's /login page over plain http. Set this and/or the three Google variables; the dashboard does not start with neither. Five wrong attempts lock the login for a few minutes.

Config.Name: GAMBIT_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional Google sign-in: client ID of a Google OAuth 2.0 client of type Web application. Set all three Google variables together, or none. Not a secret.

Config.Name: GAMBIT_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional Google sign-in: client secret of the same Google OAuth client.

Config.Name: GAMBIT_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI
Config.Description: Optional Google sign-in: the address Google sends the browser back to, ending in /auth/callback - e.g. https://gambit.example.com/auth/callback. Must be registered on the Google client EXACTLY, and the dashboard must be opened at this same host. https here also marks the cookies Secure.

Config.Name: ALPACA_PAPER_KEY_ID
Config.Description: Key id of the first Alpaca PAPER trading account. Paper only: a live key is refused. Leave empty to run without a paper account.

Config.Name: ALPACA_PAPER_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Secret key of the first Alpaca paper account.

Config.Name: ALPACA_PAPER_KEY_ID_2
Config.Description: Key id of a second Alpaca paper account (optional).

Config.Name: ALPACA_PAPER_SECRET_KEY_2
Config.Description: Secret key of the second Alpaca paper account.

Config.Name: ALPACA_PAPER_KEY_ID_3
Config.Description: Key id of a third Alpaca paper account (optional).

Config.Name: ALPACA_PAPER_SECRET_KEY_3
Config.Description: Secret key of the third Alpaca paper account.
